'''Colla IV''', or simply '''Colla''', was the [[Homeworld/Legends|home]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the [[Insectoid/Legends|insectoid]] [[Colicoid/Legends|Colicoid]] species, makers of the [[Droideka/Legends|droideka]], [[Scorpenek annihilator droid/Legends|Annihilator droid]], [[Pistoeka sabotage droid/Legends|buzz droid]], and the [[Droid tri-fighter/Legends|droid tri-fighter]]. Its [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Engineer/Legends|engineers]] were known for ingenuity rather than style.<ref name="Path to Truth">''[[Jedi Quest: Path to Truth]]''</ref>

==History==
This planet, during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], was a member of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. Additionally, the planet became the site of a [[Battle of Colla IV (Clone Wars)|battle]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

By [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], Colla IV had become an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Fortress world/Legends|fortress world]]. The [[Battle of Colla|liberation]] of the planet in [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]] was a major [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] victory.<ref name="TEA" />

Decades later, during the final stages of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], Colla IV was liberated from the invaders' control, and served as a strongpoint for [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] forces traveling between [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] and [[Commenor/Legends|Commenor]] as they prepared for the [[Battle of Yuuzhan'tar]].
